title: fix(plugin-auth): the organization, invitation-placement and phone-OTP hook refusals carry their ADR-0112 codes
body:
Fixes #24243

Clause-②: no

Eight `APIError` throws from plugin-auth's better-auth hooks answered with `message` alone, so a client could only show or pattern-match prose. Each now carries the ADR-0112 code in the spec seat's table (card comment `6248819342`, the codes landed on `main` with PR #24294), typed at the throw: `RegisteredErrorCode` for the four registered codes and `StandardErrorCode` for the four standard ones, as the invitation role cap's constants are typed, so a removed or misspelled ledger row fails `tsc`. Every refusal keeps its HTTP status.

| position at `ec749fbb4` | door | status | code |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `:1343` daily SMS quota | `/auth/phone-number/send-otp`, `/auth/phone-number/request-password-reset` | 429 | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (standard) |
| `:5761` per-number OTP limit | the same two | 429 | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (the same constant) |
| `:1358` slug guard read fault | `/auth/organization/update` | 503 | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (standard) |
| `:3464` reserved `__global__` id or slug | `/auth/organization/create` | 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` (standard) |
| `:3472` no organization wall | `/auth/organization/create` | 403 | `ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED` |
| `:3540` no placement runtime | `/auth/organization/invite-member` | 403 | `INVITE_PLACEMENT_UNSUPPORTED` |
| `:3558` placement outside the issuer's scope | `/auth/organization/invite-member` | 403 | `INVITE_PLACEMENT_OUTSIDE_ISSUER_SCOPE` |
| `:3668` slug change with an active environment | `/auth/organization/update` | 403 | `ORGANIZATION_SLUG_LOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_ENVIRONMENTS` |

## The three implementer notes

1. **The placement catch is split.** It used to answer every throw out of `assertIssuable` with 403 and the thrown message. Now only the gate's own refusal (plugin-security's `PermissionDeniedError`, read structurally by its `PERMISSION_DENIED` code, because plugin-auth has no runtime dependency on plugin-security) answers 403 `INVITE_PLACEMENT_OUTSIDE_ISSUER_SCOPE` with the gate's message. Any other throw, such as the store fault `resolveUserAuthzGrants` raises as `AuthzStoreUnavailableError`, answers 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with its code. The failure rides `cause` and its message is not relayed. This is the one behaviour change: a store fault was a 403 scope refusal and is now a 503. No invitation row is written either way. The structural interface `InvitationPlacementServiceLike` gains a doc line that states this refusal contract.
2. **The `:3668` message says only what the guard reads.** It no longer says environments "still reference" the organization or tells the caller to rename hostnames. The guard counts `sys_environment` rows by `organization_id` and `status`, and reads no hostname. The new text: "Cannot change the organization slug while the organization has N active environment(s), meaning any environment that is neither archived nor failed. Archive those environments first, or keep the current slug." The read-fault message at `:1358` had the same "still references" wording and now says "whether this organization has an active environment was never determined".
3. **The comment above `SMS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE`** no longer calls `'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS'` an ADR-0112 error code. It is the service envelope's token (better-call's status name), only matched on the way in. In the same edit, the quota wall's status is spelled `'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS'` directly rather than read off that constant, so both walls now construct the identical status and code. A sentence in the role cap's read-fault helper that this branch made false ("Unlike the slug guard's body, this one carries the code too") now reads "Like".

The console's map row for `ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED` is objectui's and is not in this PR; the seat files it at landing.

## One docs correction, outside the claim's file surface

`content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx` had two statements this branch makes false: the `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` entry said the SMS daily quota answers `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`, and the `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` entry said that code's envelope is never flat. Both are corrected: the phone-OTP walls answer 429 `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` in better-auth's flat `code` and `message` body, with no `Retry-After` header (measured: the constructed `APIError` carries `headers {}`) and no `details`. This page is not in the claim's declared surface; the report names it.

## Tests

- **The enumeration pin**, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/api-error-code.pin.test.ts` (a test, not a CI gate). It parses every non-test source file under `plugin-auth/src`, finds every `new APIError(...)`, and requires a top-level `code` in the body, or a body destructured from `judgeHeldSession(...)` in the same function (the held-session judge's envelope, whose code is nested under `error`). A comment-free textual count must equal the walked count per file, a floor (30 sites in 4 files) stops a walk that reads nothing, and a fixture battery shows the classifier both reports the code-less shapes and accepts the coded ones.
- **Control against the card's table** (one-time): with `auth-manager.ts` swapped to its `ec749fbb4` blob, the pin reports exactly `auth-manager.ts:1343, :1358, :3464, :3472, :3540, :3558, :3668, :5761`, the eight positions of the corrected enumeration (`6245494426`), and does not flag the two relayed `judgeHeldSession` bodies. Restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation, one stamp** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode): deleting the `:3668` stamp turns the pin red at that one site (`auth-manager.ts:3769` in HEAD numbering); restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation, the behaviour change**: deleting the catch's discrimination turns the store-fault pin red (`expected 403 to be 503`); restored the same way. `auth-manager.test.ts` imports `./auth-manager` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the reading.
- **Wire pins**, reached on a stock showcase boot (the production `single` posture):
  - `:3472`: `organization-create-refusal-codes.dogfood.test.ts`, a new organization answers 403 `ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED`, no row; it first asserts `/auth/config` publishes `multiOrgEnabled: false`.
  - `:3464`: the same file, the `__global__` slug answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` ahead of the posture refusal, no row.
  - `:3558`: `delegated-admin-invite.dogfood.test.ts`, a `delegated_admin` with no adminScope who requests placement is refused by the real gate with 403 `INVITE_PLACEMENT_OUTSIDE_ISSUER_SCOPE`, no row.
- **Unit pins**, each with its reason in the test:
  - `:1343` and `:5761`: `bootStack` mounts no phone-number plugin (`OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED` is read only by `objectstack serve`). The existing "both walls present the SAME outward shape" pin now asserts the one shared `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.
  - `:3668` and `:1358`: `sys_environment` is cloud-provided and no composition in this repository registers it, so the guard does not apply on a stock boot.
  - `:3540`: `bootStack` always boots plugin-security, which registers the placement service.
  - The placement store fault: it needs a store that cannot answer.
  - `:3472` is also pinned in-package through the real better-auth route (`org-create-posture-gate.test.ts`, the single and degraded postures), and `:3464` in `auth-manager.test.ts`.

The gate-refusal unit pin uses a structural stand-in for `PermissionDeniedError`. Importing plugin-security there measured roughly 1 to 2 s more import time on `auth-manager.test.ts`, and the real class reaches the catch on the wire in the dogfood pin above.

## Local readings

All on `4fc739dfb` (this branch merged with `main` at `51ad8e4fb`), the head this PR opens with:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0.
- plugin-auth's suite (`vitest run`): 161 files passed, 3126 tests passed, 10 skipped.
- dogfood, the two touched files: 2 files, 9 tests passed.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 99 commands for this diff, and all 99 exited 0 on this head. Two first refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) because packages outside this diff had no `dist/`: `check:skill-examples` (needs `client-react`) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (seven unbuilt packages). After building those, both re-ran with exit 0, and so did the four other dist-reading gates, re-run on a quiet tree. `--ran` reconciliation: 99 derived, 99 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Outside the derivation, `spec check:error-code-provenance` and `spec check:generated` (spec moved on `main`'s side of the merge) both exit 0.
- The table control and the stamp ablation ran on `cd27c533a`, the catch ablation on `00cafa8b2`. The merge brought four plugin-auth source files from `main`, which the enumeration pin also reads; run alone on this head it passes 7 of 7.
- Not run locally, and left to CI: the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, and the full dogfood suite.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/services/service-sms/src/sms-daily-quota.ts` (the comment above its `SMS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE`) says the envelope token is "the same code the per-number guard raises in plugin-auth (`APIError('TOO_MANY_REQUESTS')`)". After this PR that spelling is the shared status name, and the code both walls carry is `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`. Comment only, outside this card's surface, not touched. Carrier: none.
- The comment block above `organizationHooks` in `auth-manager.ts` still says "any lookup error is treated as 'no envs to protect'". Since the slug guard fails closed on a read fault, that is not what the code does. Comment only, not touched. Carrier: none.
- The contract review's item 8 (`beforeUpdateOrganization` does not reserve `__global__` while `beforeCreateOrganization` does) is unchanged here; the review escalated it to the seat.
- Exclusions held: no `packages/spec` edit, none of the four files PR #24325 touches, nothing in objectui.
